issues.title: EOS-018 — Workspace Registry Completion
issues.objective: Complete the existing Workspace Registry using verified existing workspace identities and locations without changing workspace architecture.
scope: Inspect existing workspace evidence first
Populate the existing Workspace Registry with unique governed workspace records
Verify identity, location, repository relationship, owner, and status
out_of_scope: Product code, Blueprint, or Operating Cycle changes
acceptance_criteria: Every registered workspace has one unique identity and verified location
No workspace or repository architecture is changed
EOS-009 has evidence suitable for PM verification

issues.title: EOS-019 — PM Verification Framework
issues.objective: Establish an evidence-based PM Verification Framework for capability review without transferring PM authority to the executor.
scope: Define verification inputs, checks, results, accountable actor, and status transitions
Map capability evidence to PM review outcomes
Preserve Completed and Verified as distinct states
out_of_scope: Product, Blueprint, Operating Cycle, or Workspace changes
deliverables: Verification result schema and review flow
acceptance_criteria: Verification requires durable evidence and explicit PM disposition
No capability becomes Verified through executor action alone
Framework aligns with all sixteen EOS capabilities

issues.title: EOS-020 — PM Closing Builder
issues.objective: Establish a PM Closing Builder that assembles reviewable daily closing evidence without performing approval or closing.
scope: Define required closing inputs and validation gates
Generate a deterministic closing package for PM review
Report missing evidence and stop conditions
out_of_scope: Product, Blueprint, Operating Cycle, or Workspace changes
acceptance_criteria: Builder produces a complete review package from valid inputs
Missing mandatory evidence stops generation
Builder never advances closing state by itself

issues.title: EOS-021 — Daily Improvement Loop (GVR-010) Implementation
issues.objective: Implement the Owner-approved Daily Improvement Loop rule GVR-010 within the existing governance architecture.
scope: Verify the approved GVR-010 source and boundary
Implement the daily evidence-to-improvement feedback loop
Define traceability, review, and carry-over controls
acceptance_criteria: Implementation traces to the approved rule
Improvement findings cannot silently expand scope
Carry-over and accountable review are explicit

issues.title: EOS-022 — Today's Planning Package Registry
issues.objective: Establish Today's Planning Package Registry as the persistent authoritative input to EOS-017, Issue Queue source, and Daily Closing comparison baseline.
scope: Extend existing planning assets first
Record mandatory Planning Package identity, status, objective, queue, success criteria, carry-over, approver, and timestamps
Define one authoritative current daily package and lifecycle traceability
out_of_scope: Publishing an Issue Queue without instruction
Product, Blueprint, Operating Cycle, or Workspace changes
acceptance_criteria: Registry identifies one authoritative daily Planning Package
EOS-017 input and Daily Closing baseline are traceable to the same package
Mandatory fields and status transitions are verifiable

issues.title: EOS v1.0 Final Certification
issues.objective: Audit final EOS v1.0 evidence and produce an accountable certification recommendation without self-certifying the system.
scope: Audit EOS-001 through EOS-016 after morning Queue execution
Verify capability evidence, dependencies, repository persistence, and PM verification readiness
Report certification recommendation and all unresolved gaps
out_of_scope: Product development or Daily Governed Closing
acceptance_criteria: All sixteen capabilities are assessed
No capability is Verified without PM evidence
Every gap and stop condition is explicit

issues.title: PVOS 1.0 — Product Baseline Review
issues.objective: Review the current PVOS 1.0 Product Baseline against durable repository evidence without changing product scope.
scope: Inspect approved Product and PM assets
Reconcile existing, specified, planned, deferred, and not-evidenced capabilities
Report baseline gaps for Product Acceptance
acceptance_criteria: Every baseline claim is evidence-linked
Excluded capabilities remain excluded
Review is ready for PM Product Acceptance flow

issues.title: PVOS 1.0 — Demo-001 Revalidation
issues.objective: Revalidate Demo-001 against the current PVOS 1.0 deterministic layout baseline and recorded expected result.
scope: Inspect immutable Demo-001 input and expected output
Run the approved build, tests, and CLI demonstration where safe
Compare geometry, ordering, count, capacity, status, and warnings
out_of_scope: Adding UI, adapters, or showcase features
acceptance_criteria: Demo execution matches approved evidence or every difference is reported
Deterministic result is tested
Repository remains free of unapproved changes

issues.title: PVOS 1.0 — Issue-to-Evidence Mapping
issues.objective: Map every PVOS 1.0 acceptance capability and governed work item to durable Issue, commit, test, and demonstration evidence.
scope: Map included PVOS 1.0 capabilities
Identify missing, conflicting, or branch-only evidence
Produce a reviewable acceptance evidence matrix
out_of_scope: Changing Blueprint, Baseline, or release scope
acceptance_criteria: Every included capability has a traceable evidence result
Missing evidence remains explicit
No branch-only evidence is represented as merged baseline

issues.title: PVOS 1.0 — PM Product Acceptance
issues.objective: Prepare and record the accountable PM Product Acceptance disposition from the reviewed PVOS 1.0 evidence package.
scope: Review baseline, Demo, and Issue-to-Evidence results
Record PM acceptance, rejection, or blocked disposition
Carry unresolved gaps forward explicitly
deliverables: PM findings and recommendation for Owner review
acceptance_criteria: Disposition references complete evidence
Accountable PM action is distinct from executor preparation
Unresolved risks remain visible

issues.title: PVOS 1.0 — Owner Product Acceptance
issues.objective: Present the PM-reviewed PVOS 1.0 acceptance package for accountable Owner Product Acceptance disposition.
scope: Present PM disposition and supporting evidence
Record Owner acceptance, rejection, or blocked result
Preserve all conditions and follow-up requirements
out_of_scope: Codex or PM acting as Owner
acceptance_criteria: Owner decision is explicit and evidence-linked
No acceptance is inferred from elapsed time or merge state
Closing remains separately governed
